entities.summary: The Yōrō Line  is a railway line of a Japanese private railway operator Yōrō Railway . The line traverses the northeastern side of the Yōrō Mountains and connects Kuwana Station in Kuwana, Mie Prefecture and Ibi Station in Ibigawa, Gifu Prefecture.
